title: Ondo carousel arrows
description: A pair of 36px square previous/next buttons with 8px corners and small chevrons, on a soft grey wash that darkens on hover; disabled ends fade out.
notes: works on light and dark bands: the wash is the foreground colour at low opacity
name: ondo-arrows

props.name: atStart
props.description: greys out the back button (at the first item)

props.name: atEnd
props.description: greys out the forward button (at the last item)

props.name: labels
props.description: screen-reader labels for the two buttons
